system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Drawing your weapon is a show that peaceful options have been exhausted. With your weapon drawn you steady yourself and settle into an almost motionless stance, giving each foe that stands against you a verdict of guilt and execution. While in this stance, if you are wielding a weapon listed under your Weapon Proficiency trait, it becomes known as your Executioners Instrument. While in this Bukijutsu stance, you gain the following benefits:

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength weapon attacks with Executioners Instrument weapons.

Yamada clan Hijutsu you cast with your Executioners Instrument can use the Ideal Cut ability listed. Beginning at 7th level, you cast can use the Tao ability listed. If you use the Tao ability, you cannot use the Ideal Cut ability, and vice versa.

When you take the Attack action with an Executioners Instrument, you can use the Empty Blade attack.

Empty Blade: You can forgo all additional attacks beyond the first one as part of this Attack Action. When you do, roll a number of d6’s equal to the forgone attacks, plus 1 if the affected creature is Severed. If you roll a 5 or 6 with a d6, you can deal additional damage equal to your [Weapon Damage], which is not multiplied as part of a critical hit.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
